observations.behavior: Adds imports and a frozen dataclass, SDK parsing, and a keyed fingerprint. P1.F1.H3 adds the _SdkIdentity class and _parse_user_agent_sdk, P1.F1.H4 adds an api_key_fingerprint parameter, P1.F1.H5 and P1.F1.H6 wire the fingerprint and SDK fields into the rejection log. P1.F2.H3 and P1.F2.H4 add a test asserting the raw token never appears in logs and that the fingerprint is stable.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds SDK name and version to the rejection log, and an HMAC-based fingerprint of the API key, while omitting the raw token. This could help PostHog correlate push-subscription rejections by SDK and group invalid-token rejections without exposing credentials.
